newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC hits new high on warrant rumours.
newsitem.headline: CITIC hits new high on warrant rumours.

text.p: Shares of Citic Pacific Ltd rose HK$0.90 or 2.56 percent to hit an all time high of HK$36 per share in late morning on rumours of a covered warrant issue on the stock, brokers said on Thursday.

"Anticipation that the warrant issuer will buy stock to cover the warrant, plus recent demand for China-related stocks, especially those backed by spinoff rumours, boosted buying," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage.
Brokers said CITIC was rumoured to be considering a spinoff of its infrastructure business. CITIC officials were not immediately available for comment. - HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
